verdict.rationale: Yubico documents its own public programmatic surfaces. These are the YubiEnterprise REST API (live public docs at console.yubico.com/apidocs/), the YubiCloud OTP validation HTTP API with a versioned protocol spec, and first-party SDKs (.NET, Android, iOS, python-fido2) that expose APIs for driving the key from code. The coverage is fragmented, though: the REST API handles fleet delivery and inventory rather than device operations, the OTP API is prose-only, and on-device control goes through local SDKs rather than one unified API. Missing for 10: a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI paths all 404), a single documented API covering device operations end to end, a sandbox with test credentials, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use.
